notes: Stall torque is a brief limit and is not the continuous torque available during walking.
Rated torque and no-load speed are different operating points, not simultaneously achievable values.
Servo has no hard stop, but the assembled robot still requires limits against collisions and cable winding.
12V reference values do not establish performance at a different supply voltage.
Mass distribution among servo CAD pieces is approximate; measured whole-servo mass is preferable.
